$description: Emmet design tokens. Mirrors the Figma variable collections 1:1 (Primitives → Semantic → Component). Generated from the live Figma file — do not hand-edit values; regenerate from Figma instead. Follows the W3C Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) format: https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/

900.$description: Exact brand navy, sourced from Figma node 1:401 (SHOP/CART nav text).

900-a50.$description: Navy/900 at 50% alpha. Exact value from the product card border, Figma node 1:87.

500.$description: Exact brand pink/magenta, sourced from Figma node 1:401.

100.$description: Exact product card background, sourced from Figma node 1:65.

gold.$description: Exact value from the real PDP color-picker swatch (Figma node 23:3).

silver.$description: Exact value from the real PDP color-picker swatch (Figma node 23:5).

display.$description: Used for all nav, price, product label, and button text in the source design.

body.$description: Not evidenced in this Figma file (Home page only) — carried over from the live site's PDP body copy. Confirm once a PDP frame exists in Figma.

300.$description: Code-only, no Figma variable yet — fills the gap between 200 and 500 at a ~1.26 ratio (14 → 18 → 22 → 28).

400.$description: Code-only, no Figma variable yet — see 300's description.

hover.$description: Defined directly in Figma (Product Card hover variant) — name/finish/price text recolor on hover. Wired to component.card.text-color-hover, used by .product-card:hover.

logo.$description: The specific shade used for the real logo/symbol vector marks — deliberately a step darker than the pink-500 used for interactive nav/footer text.

divider.$description: Plain content dividers (cart line item, cart subtotal row) — distinct from border.subtle's translucent brand-navy tint, which is reserved for card/product outlines.

inactive.$description: Muted carousel dot (PDP gallery, ProductCard swipe carousel). Was navy/900 at 50% alpha to match border.subtle; flattened to this solid tint at some point, so it's kept as its own token rather than reunited with border.subtle.

gold.$description: "Finish" is the real domain term — matches products.js's finish field — kept distinct from the primitive tier's literal material-color name.

text.$description: Renamed from "body" to avoid colliding with the primitive tier's identical leaf name when flattened to a CSS custom property.

full.$description: Renamed from "pill" to avoid colliding with the primitive tier's identical leaf name when flattened to a CSS custom property.

default.$description: The one non-pill, non-zero rounding in use (cart line-item thumbnails) — primitive.radius.md had no semantic alias at all before this, so component CSS was reaching straight past this tier.

hover.$description: Mouse-over state (pink) — a real transient :hover, distinct from the added state below even though both currently resolve to the same brand pink. Matches the real Figma variable button/bg/hover, now bound to a genuine Hover variant (Size=Compact/Large, State=Hover) on the Button component set.

added.$description: Post-click confirmation state (pink), not a hover/focus state. Added for the Button pilot component's State variant.

padding-x.$description: Compact size (product cards). Also used as the Large/PDP variant's vertical padding turned out to reuse this same compact value — see padding-y.

padding-y.$description: Used for both Compact and Large sizes — checked against the real PDP button (Figma node 11:1362) and its vertical padding measures ~3.6px, matching this compact value, not padding-y-large. Only the horizontal padding and font size actually scale up for Large.

padding-x-large.$description: Large size (PDP) — confirmed against the real button container (Figma node 11:1362, 24px measured).

padding-y-large.$description: Was {primitive.space.150}, defined but unused (the real Figma button, node 11:1362, actually reuses the compact padding-y). Now deliberately diverges from Figma — the Large button was changed to match .cart-checkout-btn's proportions instead, which uses this same value.

font-size-large.$description: Was {semantic.font.size.nav} (28px), confirmed against the real button text (Figma node 11:1366). Now deliberately diverges from Figma — matches .cart-checkout-btn's font-size instead, per an explicit request to align the two.

tracking-large.$description: Was {semantic.font.tracking.nav} — see font-size-large's description; tracks the same match-the-cart-button change.

text-color-hover.$description: All Product Card text (name, finish, price) on the card's Hover variant — consolidated onto this one token instead of price having its own separate (identical-value) color token. Flat sibling (not nested under text-color) to avoid restructuring the existing default token and breaking its --card-text-color CSS var name.

divider-color.$description: Cart line-item and subtotal-row dividers (.cart-item, .cart-summary) — was a raw primitive.color.gray.200 reference in styles.css with no semantic/component tier in between.

item-image-radius.$description: Original cart.js thumbnail radius (.cart-item img). The redesigned neutral-theme cart row (.cart-item--detailed img) deliberately overrides this back to 0 — see that rule's own comment in styles.css.

dot-inactive.$description: PDP gallery and ProductCard swipe-carousel dots (.pdp-gallery-dots, .card-media-dots), inactive state.

dot-active.$description: Same dots, active state — reuses the brand accent like nav/footer links do.
